osmNote: 41,447 OSM outlines carry better geometry than the ML-derived footprints for the same buildings; 14,890 GlobalML footprints are marked superseded and must not be drawn. GlobalML remains the systematic base for everything OSM has not mapped.
partsNote: 757 OSM building:part slabs give real 3D massing — setbacks, overhangs and roof shapes — for 163 footprints. Those footprints are drawn from their parts instead of extruded flat, which is what makes a tower look like a tower rather than a prism.
